/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-05.md:L46: Dave: If I'm having trouble coming up with ideas, I usually immerse myself in something I love, like concerts or my favorite albums. Doing that usually helps to jumpstart my inspiration. Maybe try taking a break from music and explore other things. Plus, have some fun while you're at it!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave! It's been a while! Crazy stuff has been happening. Last week I threw a small party at my Japanese house for my new album. It was amazing, so much love from my fam and friends! Take a look at the photo of the party in the mansion, it was so energizing!
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L16: Dave: Congrats on your album release and the party, Calvin! Must've been a great feeling having your loved ones show their support.
/memories/music-and-performance/session-16.md:L29: Calvin: Cool! Last weekend I started shooting a video for my new album - can't wait for you to check it out! Look how great it was!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-18.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave! Sorry it took me so long to get back to you. Crazy times since we talked! My album finally dropped on the 11th and it was a wild feeling. Everyone's been loving it and it's motivated me to keep going.
/memories/music-and-performance/session-18.md:L15: Dave: Hey Calvin! Congrats on your album release - that's awesome! Has it been overwhelming or inspiring?
/memories/photography/session-27.md:L44: Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! Your car project sounds amazing. I've had some great collaborations recently and my album is almost finished. I'll send you some previews soon. Let me know when you're free for a catch-up.
/memories/travel-and-outdoors/session-08.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave! Met with the creative team for my album yesterday. It was a long session, but awesome to see everything coming together. 
/memories/travel-and-outdoors/session-08.md:L15: Dave: Hey Cal! Sounds great that your album's coming along. Are you feeling good about it? Here's a pic I just took.
/memories/travel-and-outdoors/session-08.md:L19: Calvin: Dave, thanks for checking in. I'm feeling stoked about this album! We've been making some magic with a team in the studio, working on the music and everything. Look at what a wonderful studio we have! How have you been? Anything new since we talked?
